title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
blurb: A lone astronaut wakes up light-years from home with no memory and one job: save Earth. Science-powered problem solving and an unforgettable friendship.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
blurb: Stranded on Mars, a botanist has to science his way to survival, one sarcastic log entry at a time.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
blurb: Politics, prophecy and giant sandworms on the desert planet Arrakis. The epic that shaped modern science fiction.

title: Recursion
author: Blake Crouch
blurb: A detective and a neuroscientist chase a technology that lets people relive memories, and reality starts to unravel.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
blurb: Minutes before Earth is demolished, Arthur Dent hitches a ride into the most absurd, hilarious corners of the universe.

title: Klara and the Sun
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
blurb: An Artificial Friend watches the human world from a shop window and learns what it means to love. Quiet, luminous, haunting.

title: Station Eleven
author: Emily St. John Mandel
blurb: After a pandemic collapses civilisation, a travelling troupe keeps Shakespeare alive, because survival is insufficient.

title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
blurb: Between life and death is a library holding every life you could have lived. Which one would you choose?

title: The House in the Cerulean Sea
author: TJ Klune
blurb: A by-the-book caseworker is sent to an island orphanage of magical children, and his grey life bursts into colour.

title: Legends & Lattes
author: Travis Baldree
blurb: A battle-weary orc retires her sword to open the first coffee shop in town. Low stakes, warm heart.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
blurb: A comfort-loving hobbit is swept into an adventure with dwarves, a wizard and a dragon guarding a mountain of gold.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
blurb: A legendary hero tells his own story, from street orphan to the most gifted student magic has ever seen.

title: Circe
author: Madeline Miller
blurb: The Greek witch banished to an island finds her power, and her voice, in a lyrical retelling of myth.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
blurb: On their fifth anniversary, Amy disappears. Every chapter flips what you thought you knew about her marriage.

title: The Thursday Murder Club
author: Richard Osman
blurb: Four retirees in a peaceful village meet weekly to discuss cold cases, until a real murder lands on their doorstep.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
blurb: Ten strangers, one island, no way off, and they start dying one by one. Christie's most ingenious puzzle.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
blurb: A painter shoots her husband and never speaks again. Her therapist is determined to find out why.

title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
author: Gabrielle Zevin
blurb: Two friends build video games together across thirty years of love, rivalry and creative partnership.

title: A Man Called Ove
author: Fredrik Backman
blurb: The grumpiest man on the street gets an unwanted new neighbour, and a second chance at life.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
blurb: A shepherd boy crosses the desert in search of treasure and discovers what it means to follow your dream.

title: The Kite Runner
author: Khaled Hosseini
blurb: A story of friendship, betrayal and redemption between two boys in Kabul, and the long road back.

title: The Little Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
blurb: A pilot stranded in the desert meets a small prince from a distant asteroid. A tiny book with a giant heart.

title: The Prophet
author: Kahlil Gibran
blurb: Poetic essays on love, work, joy and sorrow, offered by a departing prophet to the people who loved him.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
blurb: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr Darcy misjudge each other spectacularly in the wittiest romance ever written.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
blurb: A reclusive Hollywood icon finally tells the truth about her glamorous, scandalous life, and the love behind it.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
blurb: How a modest ape came to rule the planet: a sweeping history of humankind, from stone tools to algorithms.

title: A Short History of Nearly Everything
author: Bill Bryson
blurb: From the Big Bang to us, explained with wonder and wit by the most curious traveller there is.

title: The Body
author: Bill Bryson
blurb: A guided tour of the machine you live in, packed with astonishing facts and Bryson's trademark humour.

title: The Gene
author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
blurb: The story of heredity, from Mendel's peas to gene editing, woven with the author's own family history.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
blurb: The two systems that drive how we think, and the surprising, predictable ways they lead us astray.

title: Range
author: David Epstein
blurb: Why generalists triumph in a specialised world, and why a winding path is often the fastest one.

title: Quiet
author: Susan Cain
blurb: The power of introverts in a world that can't stop talking, and how to make the most of a quiet strength.

title: The Courage to Be Disliked
author: Ichiro Kishimi & Fumitake Koga
blurb: A philosopher and a young man debate their way through Adlerian psychology and the freedom to be yourself.

title: Man's Search for Meaning
author: Viktor E. Frankl
blurb: A psychiatrist's account of surviving the camps, and his insight that meaning can be found in any circumstance.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
blurb: Tiny changes, remarkable results: a practical system for building good habits and breaking bad ones.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
blurb: Focus is the superpower of the distracted age. Rules for doing your most valuable, undistracted work.

title: Ikigai
author: Héctor García & Francesc Miralles
blurb: Lessons from the long-lived people of Okinawa on finding your reason to get up in the morning.

title: Show Your Work!
author: Austin Kleon
blurb: Ten ways to share your creativity and get discovered, without being a self-promoting bore.

title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
blurb: Short stories about how people think about money, and why behaviour beats intelligence when it comes to wealth.

title: Shoe Dog
author: Phil Knight
blurb: Nike's founder tells the chaotic, near-bankrupt early days of building a brand from the trunk of his car.

title: Steve Jobs
author: Walter Isaacson
blurb: The definitive portrait of the restless, brilliant and difficult founder who reshaped six industries.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
blurb: Raised off the grid with no schooling, a girl teaches herself enough to reach Cambridge, at a profound cost.

title: Born a Crime
author: Trevor Noah
blurb: Growing up mixed-race under apartheid, told with the sharp humour and warmth of a born storyteller.

title: The Gruffalo
author: Julia Donaldson & Axel Scheffler
blurb: A clever mouse outwits the predators of the deep dark wood by inventing a monster, who turns out to be real.

title: Where the Wild Things Are
author: Maurice Sendak
blurb: Sent to bed without supper, Max sails away to the land of the Wild Things and becomes their king.

title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
author: Charlie Mackesy
blurb: Four unlikely friends share gentle wisdom about kindness, courage and asking for help.

title: The Dot
author: Peter H. Reynolds
blurb: Vashti is sure she can't draw, until her teacher asks her to make a mark and see where it takes her. A small book about being brave.
